author: Microsoft
description:
The London-based startup Wayve is transforming driverless technology with an AI‑driven neural net that learns to navigate independently. Microsoft Azure supplies the GPU horsepower and cloud tools needed to train on petabytes of video, enabling safer, more adaptable autonomous vehicles that can quickly learn to drive themselves in cities across the globe.
